messages.content:
Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 with product ID p_sony_xm5_blk is in stock. If it isn’t, look for trending alternatives in the electronics category and choose one recommendation to buy. Then reserve quantity 1 of the selected item, confirm the order, format the order details, find alice’s contact info, and email her a purchase update with the subject “Purchase update.” Please use paypal for payment and make sure this is for user_123.

After that, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, check the latest business news, create a medium-priority document titled “Shopping and finance workflow summary” using that business news content, and email it to me. Finally, retrieve my checking account balance sheet and archive it with the title “Balance archive after substitute purchase” as a medium-priority email notification.
